connection_authentication.note: Mode 2 has no MAC; mode 6 (v6) has a 4-byte tag verified by a pure function (not an HMAC) and no sample exists. The mere presence of a hash helper in libcore.so proves nothing about connection authentication. VPN transport and connection authentication were not researched for this build.
connection_authentication.rule: The mere presence of an HMAC library or a Mac.init call confirms nothing. No key values and no hook inputs/outputs are stored in this dossier.
